definitions.explanation: Very bad, unpleasant, or severe. Can describe situations, weather, behavior, or treatment.
Beyond what is normal or acceptable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひどい⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: The weather is terrible today, isn't it?

examples.japanese: ひどい⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}わないで→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't say such awful things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひどく⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧ひどい⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Don't do such a terrible thing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひどく⟦{混|こ}んでいて→混む：02574_komu⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おく}れて→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧⟦しまいました→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: The road was terribly congested, and I was late for work.

examples.japanese: ひどい⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひどい。
⟦{頭痛|ずつう}→頭痛：03369_zutsuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひどくて⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: My headache is so bad I can't work.

examples.japanese: ひどく⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。

notes:
ひどい is an i-adjective describing something terrible, cruel, or excessive. It covers a wide range from "awful" to "severe."

FORMS:
- Adverbial: ひどく (terribly, extremely)
- Te-form: ひどくて
- Past: ひどかった
- Noun form: ひどさ (severity, awfulness)

WRITING:
Can be written as ⟦{酷|ひど}い→酷い：noentry⟧, but hiragana is more common.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ひどい⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧: to have a terrible experience
- ひどい⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to say cruel things
- ひどい⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧: an awful story / that's terrible

USAGE:
As an adverb (ひどく), it intensifies the following word: ひどく⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧ (extremely tired), ひどく⟦{混|こ}んでいる→混む：02574_komu⟧ (terribly crowded). When describing worsening conditions, use ひどく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひどく⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧ (the cold got worse).
